data.turoyo: Əmmo: “Gawi w ḥaṣi.” I ǧeriye məllala, əmmo: “D l əzze d lo hat ṭʕənto?” Əmmo: “Lo kuḏʕono.” Əmmo: “Mar, nošo layt.” Əmmo: “Təx guš.” Əmmo: “Ṭʕənto hat.”
data.translation: »Am Bauch und an den Hüften«, antwortete sie. Die Dienerin sprach zu ihr: »Du wirst doch nicht etwa schwanger sein?« »Ich weiss nicht«. »Sage es nur, es ist ja niemand hier«. »Komm, befüle mich«, bat die Braut. »Ja, du bist schwanger«, sagte die Dienerin

rationale: New Imperativ box guš; body-pain and pregnancy context makes tactile examination clear.

summary: New box Infinitiv: example for sense 1 in Infinitiv (Jan 3.1/22)

data.turoyo: Kobaʕno, kulle dlo giyošo appe, xəd kənne, d məfrosi."
data.translation: I want all of them to be published as they are, without touching their face.'

rationale: First Infinitiv box; publishing “as they are” supplies a textual-interference extension of touching. The machine rendering of appe as “their face” is retained as supplied but is not endorsed; appe is the existing b-series plural target.

data.turoyo: Elo Laʕle lo+maqbela lo+doṯən lbabi, w lo lbe… lu+babo di+Faho, w be mxalati Malke, lo+gəšše panək.
data.translation: But Laʕle did not agree that they should come either to my father or to the family of…. to Faho’s father, and cousin Malke’s family, they did not touch those ones.
data.ref: MAC Murder in Kfarze, The Testimony of Farida/75

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC NE Old lady and a bird/33)

data.turoyo: Omar, ‘Ḥur, kalá i+xurǧk̇ayḏi harke dlo+gayšat eba! I+čalṭayḏi kalá harke dlo+gayšat eba.’ Omar, ‘Lo, lo!’
data.translation: He says, ‘Look, there’s my saddlebag here, so don’t touch it! My handbag, here it is, so don’t touch it!’ He says, ‘No, no!’
data.ref: MAC NE Old lady and a bird/33

rationale: First sense-1 Infectum example; two repeated bag prohibitions in one short context.

evidence.cite: MAC NE Old lady and a bird/33

data.turoyo: U ḥa yawmo ono stene ṭreli i ḥšəmto du babo w maḥtoli taḥte di mkabbe w məllila əmmono: "Ḥur, i ḥšəmto d babax, d lo gayšat eba!" — Məlla: "Abadan lo gayšono eba.
data.translation: Eines Tages stelle ich das Abendbrat des Vaters unter den Deckel und sage zu ihr: Gib acht! Rühre nicht an das Abendbrat deines Vaters! - Sie sprach: Ich werde es bestimmt nicht anrühren.

rationale: Thin sense-1 Infectum cell; a warning and 1sg feminine reply share the same b-target, quoted once for both tokens.

summary: All 12 occurrences checked. Sense 1 normally has b-marked targets (eba, appe), but bare panək (MAC Farida/75) and ʕal qarʕa (PrS 67/73) show that 'meist mit b-' already correctly allows variation; no gloss change needed.

guš in PrS 5/4 is a clear root-shaped Imperativ in a request for tactile examination. In contrast dlo+gayšat and d lo gayšat are negative Infectum clauses; their directive force does not make a new Imperativ form.
Not touching a protected woman or protected families can mean doing no harm in context; this is already represented by the entry's 56/10 example. No independent 'harm' sense is justified.
Warnings not to touch supper and the daughter's answer in 113/141 imply taking/eating it; sense 1 still covers contact/interference. The edition's later eating verb supplies the consumption event.

The sole spying use gayšo xabro at PrS 19/36 repeats the existing quotation under a legacy reference. No duplicate or unverified citation correction. 36/109 and 56/10 likewise repeat existing examples.
giyošo is an action nominal under dlo; it adds a previously absent Infinitiv box, not a new stem.

The reader’s “their face” claim misidentifies appe, already attested as b-series plural target in the round-1 contact example. The machine translation carries the same literalisation and must not be used as semantic proof.
Confirm guš as the Imperativ of the supplied gəšle/goyəš paradigm; the patient is implicit in Turoyo and made explicit by the German.
Do bare panək and ʕal qarʕa differ dialectally or by contact construction from b-marked targets? The small sample does not establish distribution.
Reconcile PrS 19/36 with legacy prs 47/21 before changing the existing reference.
Review the project machine translation’s “their face” at Jan 3.1/22; appe is the b-series target. Confirm whether preserving documents xəd kənne concerns wording, presentation, or both.
Documents to be published xəd kənne are to remain untouched: contextually no interference or alteration. Keep under touching; no separate wording-specific sense is established.
